sources.title: alphaedge-ai/whisper-large-v3-turbo-kaz-16384 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is a 5.61% whisper-large-v3-turbo version of openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo optimized for Kazakh language via vocabulary size reduction using the trimming method. This trimmed model should perform similarly to the original model with only 16,384 tokens and a much smaller memory footprint.

sources.title: shyngys879/kazakh-whisper-large-v3-turbo · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model is fine-tuned from openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo on a large-scale cleaned Kazakh ASR mixture containing 841,113 training utterances, approximately 1,500+ hours of Kazakh speech. This is a merged full Transformers model, so it can be loaded directly with transformers using pipeline () or WhisperForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained ().
